notes: 10.3: the self-learning release - the app now learns from your corrections (one fix teaches a sound-alike pair, your own usage decides, it never guesses), understands your accent's sound-alikes, gains a shape rule so word repair can never rewrite your technical vocabulary, collapses echoed acronyms with proof, and the correction watcher checks sooner and never gives up silently - see fabledflow.com/changelog.html#v10-3.
